WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-86.875419 40.417368, -86.875414 40.417302, -86.875412 40.417274, -86.874618 40.416585, -86.874562 40.416536, -86.874494 40.416476, -86.874121 40.416145, -86.873706 40.415775, -86.873289 40.415405, -86.872927 40.415082, -86.872867 40.415028)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-105.004258 39.742011, -105.004253 39.742004, -105.003833 39.741452, -105.003511 39.741029)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Grant Street' ELSE '9th Street' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

),

  SELECT 
    ST_Avg(ST_Slope(ST_Clip(r.rast, true, g.geom), 1)) AS avg_slope
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    grant_street_geom g

    ST_Intersects(r.rast, g.geom)

    ninth_street_geom n

    ST_Intersects(r.rast, n.geom)

  END AS higher_slope_street,
  g.avg_slope AS grant_street_avg_slope,
  n.avg_slope AS ninth_street_avg_slope
FROM 
  grant_street_slope g,
  ninth_street_slope n;
